text:
Original BERT4Rec already includes terminal-item masking: §3.6 explicitly adds training samples with only the last item masked, describing this as working like fine-tuning for next-item recommendation. Inference appends a mask and predicts from its representation. The paper does not specify the terminal-sample mixing ratio or establish a separate fine-tuning stage. Thus, adding terminal-mask supervision alone is not a distinct conceptual intervention. [BERT4Rec paper](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1904.06690)

Public implementations differ. The authors’ published generator uses overlapping sliding windows and duplicated random-Cloze samples; its training entry point passes `force_last=False`, while explicit forced-last masking is used for evaluation. Random masking can still select a window’s last item. Defaults include duplication factor 10, masking fraction 0.15, at least one target, a target-count cap, and replacement with the mask token with probability 1.0. These are generator defaults, not necessarily experiment settings. [Authors’ generator](https://github.com/FeiSun/BERT4Rec/blob/master/gen_data.py) The public PyTorch implementation instead dynamically applies independent Bernoulli target selection with 80/10/10 mask/random/unchanged replacement, then retains the latest fixed-length suffix; it has no explicit terminal-only branch or random prefix truncation. [PyTorch sampler](https://github.com/jaywonchung/BERT4Rec-VAE-Pytorch/blob/master/dataloaders/bert.py)

A mixed Cloze/random-prefix terminal-mask proposal therefore needs a precise sampler comparison: baseline terminal-only probability; prefix endpoint distribution and eligible lengths; user versus window sampling; truncation order; fixed versus refreshed masks; masking rate, target-count cap and zero-target handling; corruption probabilities; and loss weighting per target versus per sequence. Define terminal examples as `[v₁,…,vₜ₋₁,MASK] → vₜ`, excluding later interactions. The potentially distinct change is the distribution and weighting of sampled prefix endpoints; originality remains unestablished without documenting the supplied baseline and broader prior art.
